entries.title: Isaiah 46:1
segments:
CHAP. XLVI. 
 
  The ruin of Babylon and her idols, ver. 1-2.   God's love and faithfulness to the Jews. ver. 3-4.   Idols not to be compared with God, ver. 5-8.   for power, knowledge, and sure salvation, ver. 9-13. 
 
  V. 1. Bel-The chief idol of the Babylonians, called by profane historians Jupiter Belus.  Boweth-As the Babylonians used to bow down to him to worship, so now he bows down to the victorious Persians. Nebo-Another of the famous idols, which used to deliver oracles. Their idols-Were taken and broken, and the materials of them, gold, silver, and brass, were carried upon beasts into Persia. Your carriages-O ye Persians, to whom he turns his speech.

entries.title: Isaiah 46:2
segments: V. 2. They-The Babylonians.  Together-The Babylonians and their idols together, neither could help the other.  Deliver-The Babylonians could not deliver their idols.

entries.title: Isaiah 46:3
segments: V. 3. Carried-Whom I have nourished, ever since you were a people, and came out of Egypt; and that as tenderly, as parents bring up their own children.

entries.title: Isaiah 46:7
segments: V. 7. Remove-He can stir neither hand nor foot to help his people.

entries.title: Isaiah 46:8
segments: V. 8. Bring it-Think of this again and again, ye who have been guilty of this foolish sin.

entries.title: Isaiah 46:10
segments: V. 10. Declaring-Foretelling from the beginning of the world, future events which should happen in succeeding ages, even to the end of the world.

entries.title: Isaiah 46:11
segments: V. 11. A bird-Cyrus, called a bird for his swiftness, and ravenous for his fierceness, and victoriousness over his enemies.

entries.title: Isaiah 46:13
segments: V. 13. I bring-Tho' you are unrighteous, I will shew myself a righteous and faithful God, making good my promise of delivering you out of Babylon after seventy years.  It-My work of saving you from the Babylonish captivity.  Will place-I will bring my people to Zion, and save them from all their enemies.  My glory-In whom I will once again glory as my people.
